metadata.description: Cursor/Grok Bot plugins for AI agent teams: git-based memory, EVM development, creator workflows, and skill security

plugins.name: second-brain
plugins.description: Shared, user-owned memory for AI agents in a plain-markdown Obsidian vault synced through git

plugins.name: ethereum-builder
plugins.description: Ethereum/EVM development and onchain research tools. Includes ethskills routing, Blockscout lookups, Dune analysis, token due diligence, and protocol research workflows

plugins.name: creator-voice
plugins.description: Build reusable writing-voice profiles, draft social content in your voice, and humanize AI text. Draft-only workflows for X posts, threads, changelogs, and video repurposing.

plugins.name: skill-vetter
plugins.description: Security-first skill and plugin vetting for Cursor/Grok Bot. Check skills and plugins BEFORE installation for data exfiltration, credential reads, remote code execution, hidden instructions, and over-broad permissions. Reports pass/warn/fail verdicts with clear findings.
